subject: maths
question: The radius of a solid sphere is 42 cm. It is melted to form identical small solid spheres whose radius is 7 cm. What is the number of small solid spheres obtained ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of smaller spheres (n) = (Radius of larger sphere ÷ Radius of smaller sphere)³

n = (42 ÷ 7)³

n = (6)³

n = 216

**∴ The correct answer is 216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of larger solid sphere (R) = 42 cm

Radius of each small solid sphere (r) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × radius³

Number of spheres (n) = Volume of larger sphere ÷ Volume of one small sphere

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5720751bc0696c50f3f4d9a724b7e1f273a7911ff608b9fed53fc6a786e8add9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of larger sphere = (4/3) × π × (42)³

⇒ Volume of smaller sphere = (4/3) × π × (7)³

⇒ n × (4/3) × π × (7)³ = (4/3) × π × (42)³

⇒ n × 7 × 7 × 7 = 42 × 42 × 42

⇒ n = (42 × 42 × 42) ÷ (7 × 7 × 7)

⇒ n = 6 × 6 × 6

⇒ n = 216

**∴ The correct answer is 216.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere. Its volume is given by V = (2/3) × π × r³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a solid sphere is given by A = 4 × π × r².

Law of Conservation of Volume

When one solid object is melted and recast into another shape(s), the total volume remains constant, provided there is no wastage during the process.</p
